ruleDefinitions.fye-month-change: The month of the period end changes between consecutive annual rows, or between consecutive fq 4 rows. The first changed row of each series is reported.
ruleDefinitions.q4-end-vs-annual-end: A fq 4 row ends more than 7 days from every annual end of the same fiscal year.
ruleDefinitions.quarter-spacing: Consecutive quarterly rows (by end) are not a whole number n of 12-17 week quarters apart, or fq does not advance by n modulo 4. The later row is flagged.
ruleDefinitions.quarter-vs-annual-calendar: A quarterly row (fq 1-4) does not end between 84k - 7 and 119k + 7 days before any same-fy annual end, where k = 4 - fq.
